### GTIF AT EA – Austrian Climate Change Explorer for Tourism





*Tourism indicators: Tourism and climate correlation analysis*



Daily precipitation sum, maximum temperature, and snow depth data are spatially aggregated to Austrian tourism destinations for the period 2023-2026 during winter (November-April) and summer (May-October) seasons. Snow depth values are considered only during the winter season. The climate variables are subsequently linked with forecasted overnight stays for the corresponding tourism regions.



By selecting a tourist destination on the map, the graphical representations of the relationship between overnight stays and climate factors (mean precipitation sum, maximum temperature, and mean snow depth) during the winter and/or summer seasons can be explored.



Read narrative (general) and (use case 3) for a more detailed description.
title: Tourism & Climate Correlation Analysis
